title: Claude Code expands with 5 MCP servers #claudecode #mcpservers #aiworkflow
description:
Claude Code becomes far more powerful with five MCP servers that extend it beyond a standard coding assistant. Perplexity MCP adds live internet access, Playwright enables browser control and app testing, Firecrawl crawls entire websites for research and RAG, Glyph connects to image and video generation models, and Chrome MCP lets Claude interact with active Chrome sessions.

Together, these tools turn Claude into a workflow engine for research, automation, web interaction, and creative production. The key advantage is direct action inside the workspace instead of switching between separate apps, tabs, and AI tools.

Phygital+ is also positioned as a unified workspace for AI creative work, combining 30+ tools in one place. The broader shift is toward agentic AI setups where MCP servers connect models like Claude to live data, browsers, media generation, and full production pipelines.
